paragraphs: I'm applying for the Senior Associate, Strategic Finance role supporting Toast's International organization. I'm an MBA Finance (STEM) candidate at Fordham Gabelli in New York, and before school I worked at JPMorgan Asset Management, Lenovo and Thomson Reuters. The role interests me because it is close to the numbers but also answers the real questions about how each new market is doing and where the next dollar should go.

At Lenovo I built forecasts and scenario models to evaluate capital allocation, which improved capital efficiency by 15%, and I ran variance and sensitivity analyses on budget reallocation options for cross-functional teams. At JPMorgan I worked on budget allocation across marketing channels, benchmarking past allocations against peers and finding 30% efficiency gains to guide reinvestment. Earlier, at Thomson Reuters, I supported monthly P&L forecasting, variance analysis and close for the ANZ region, so working on a market outside the U.S. is familiar.

Partnering with sales, marketing and onboarding leaders on budgets, headcount plans and unit economics is the work I want to do next. I like turning a model into a clear recommendation that a non-finance audience can act on. I'd welcome the chance to talk.
